description: Add a letter or document whose text you wrote with the person. Have It Printed typesets it on US Letter paper in a clean serif font, in black and white, and counts its pages. Plain text only: separate paragraphs with a blank line; no images, tables or formatting. Call once per document.

text.description: the full text to print, exactly as it should read

title.description: a short name for the document; it names the file and is not printed

name: hip_add_text_document
title: Add a written document
